note: A one-representation fallback serves a spelling per instant, not over the order slice: Parent maps Value as Valuenew, which SCB delivered beside Valueold in 2016 only, so Parent serves Valueold's 2017-2018 and T2016's own Old column serves 2016. A Valueold order for 2016-2018 is one slice; it extracts 2016 from T2016 and 2017-2018 once, from Parent, and drops Child (its projection, which the builder admits as parent-served). Fails if the order judges the fallback over the whole slice: Parent is then refused for the 2016 co-delivery, Child is still dropped, and 2017-2018 is a coverage_gap the coverage view reports as held.

body.name: Synthetic projection served past a co-delivery
